description: Neutral configuration of the Ralph Docker integration (test/integration/ralph-sandbox.test.js). `sandbox` is the source image built by the package's own sandbox.buildImage; `stubImage` is derived from it by test/fixtures/ralph-sandbox/Dockerfile with a stub `claude` first in PATH. `service` is the controlled HTTPS service (a minimal npm registry) reachable only on a test network, under an allowlisted and a not allowlisted name. No real credentials, no real registry after the images are prepared.
